limits: Unapproved task-local prototype; canonical runtime interfaces and rule authority are unchanged.
Four retained episodes use one seed, medium difficulty, three demonstrations, and one query.
The ambiguous diagnostic is intentionally constructed and is not an observed natural solver failure.
The equivalent control identifies query answers while leaving the parameter unresolved.
Only nearest/farthest parameter rivals are checked; no claim covers all possible rules or seeds.
Named generated double-marker profiles cover lateral sides; the separate lawful witness covers all four extrema.

parameter_spec.input_constraints: Both settings use the selected generator's unchanged sparse-lattice input grammar.
parameter_spec.meaning: Choose the nearest or farthest exterior marker independently on each occupied side.
parameter_spec.name: marker_selection
parameter_spec.selection: One SHA-256-derived setting per episode seed; an explicit setting overrides that one draw.
parameter_spec.teaching_constraint: A demonstration must distinguish the settings before a query needs the distinction.

farthest.racket_text:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((cells (find-color g 3))
                  (marks (find-color g 6))
                  (r0 (min-of fst cells))
                  (r1 (max-of fst cells))
                  (c0 (min-of snd cells))
                  (c1 (max-of snd cells))
                  (above (filter (lambda (p)
                                   (and (< (fst p) r0) (>= (snd p) c0) (<= (snd p) c1)))
                                 marks))
                  (below (filter (lambda (p)
                                   (and (> (fst p) r1) (>= (snd p) c0) (<= (snd p) c1)))
                                 marks))
                  (lefts (filter (lambda (p) (< (snd p) c0)) marks))
                  (rights (filter (lambda (p) (> (snd p) c1)) marks))
                  (nr0 (if (empty? above) r0 (+ 1 (min-of fst above))))
                  (nr1 (if (empty? below) r1 (- (max-of fst below) 1)))
                  (nc0 (if (empty? lefts) c0 (+ 1 (min-of snd lefts))))
                  (nc1 (if (empty? rights) c1 (- (max-of snd rights) 1)))
                  (full-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                                       (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 3))
                                             (range c0 (+ c1 1))))
                                     (range r0 (+ r1 1))))
                  (full-cols (filter (lambda (c)
                                       (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 3))
                                             (range r0 (+ r1 1))))
                                     (range c0 (+ c1 1))))
                  (base (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v 6) 6 0))))
             (define (map-r r) (cond ((= r r0) nr0) ((= r r1) nr1) (else r)))
             (define (map-c c) (cond ((= c c0) nc0) ((= c c1) nc1) (else c)))
             (define (paint-h acc r)
               (reduce (lambda (a c) (set-cell a r c 3)) acc (range nc0 (+ nc1 1))))
             (define (paint-v acc c)
               (reduce (lambda (a r) (set-cell a r c 3)) acc (range nr0 (+ nr1 1))))
             (recolor-cells (reduce (lambda (acc c) (paint-v acc (map-c c)))
                                    (reduce (lambda (acc r) (paint-h acc (map-r r)))
                                            base
                                            full-rows)
                                    full-cols)
                            marks
                            6)))))
